basic_details.job_title: Shahajiraje Mahavidyalaya Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Chandrahar Patil Gramin Shikshan Sanstha's Shahajiraje Mahavidyalaya, Khatav (Tal. Khatav, Dist. Satara, Maharashtra), affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, has invited applications for 1 post of Principal, open to all. Applications are sent to the undersigned, the President of the Sanstha, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement dated 23 November 2026, which is about 8 December 2026 (15 days from 23 November 2026). The notice is published at www.unishivaji.ac.in.

qualification.details: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales remains in force. The post of Principal is treated as open category, as per the decision of the Hon'ble High Court, Aurangabad Bench, W/P No. 3108/2023, the special leave petition of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, W/P No. 4172/2024, and letter No. RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. | The notice does not print the educational qualification or the pay amount itself. Candidates should check the Government Resolution and the university rules named in the notice for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales remains in force. The post of Principal is treated as open category, as per the decision of the Hon'ble High Court, Aurangabad Bench, W/P No. 3108/2023, the special leave petition of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, W/P No. 4172/2024, and letter No. RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. The notice does not print the educational qualification or the pay amount itself. Candidates should check the Government Resolution and the university rules named in the notice for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.pay: As prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: Appointment to the post of Principal will be for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier. Vacant posts and all the terms and conditions apply as mentioned in the No Objection letter HTED-E-File No- 1869769/2025-MHT-(HE-5) dated 13/10/2026 from the Hon. Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai. All the terms and conditions apply as mentioned in the GR dated 12.11.2021 of the Higher and Technical Education Department of the Government of Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q1. How many Principal posts are vacant at Shahajiraje Mahavidyalaya, Khatav?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacant post of Principal, and it is open to all (Open to All - 1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement is dated 23 November 2026, so the deadline is about 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The notice states that educational qualifications are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. GR dated 08 March 2019 remains in force.

faq.question: Q4. How is the pay of the Principal decided?
faq.answer: Pay scales are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The notice prints no pay amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the President of Chandrahar Patil Gramin Shikshan Sanstha, Khatav (Satara), within 15 days from the date of publication. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Principal post permanent?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Can a person already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Principal post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No category is named. The post is treated as open category, with Open to All - 1, as per the High Court decision and the Regional Joint Director's letter cited in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Does any court case affect this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015.
